**A stronger tissue box lid: twice-as-thick tabs, a bigger catch on the hooks, and every tab at an end the same size.** The web version has it too: <https://rickusinggithub.github.io/vaseinator/>.

### Download & run (Windows)
1. Download **Vaseinator.exe** below and run it. It is one file: nothing to unzip or install. SHA256SUMS.txt holds its checksum.
2. The app isn't code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may say "Windows protected your PC". Click **More info → Run anyway**.

No Python needed. To run from source on any OS, see the README. Or just use it in your browser: <https://rickusinggithub.github.io/vaseinator/>.

### Changed in 1.15.4
- **Twice as thick, so they don't break.** The hooks are now 3.2 mm thick (from 1.6 mm), and the latches 2 mm (from 1 mm).
- **The hooks catch further**: 1 mm behind the ledge, from 0.7 mm. They go in tilted, so they needn't bend. The latches still catch by **Lid grip** - Gentle, Snug or Firm; being thicker, they are stiffer to click in.
- **Fixed: the tabs at one end could differ in size.** On a textured cover the wall measures a little differently at each tab, and each was made to fit its own spot - up to 1.3 mm different in height. Now all the tabs at an end are one shape, each just inside the wall where it stands.
- It fits the covers you've already printed: save the lid again.

Vaseinator is free. If it has made you something you like, you can [buy me a coffee](https://ko-fi.com/rickapps).
